response.explanation: src/presentation/server.ts is the process entry point. It also acts as the composition root: it builds every repository and external client and passes them into the business services. On line 3 it imports PuckPayClient from the persistence layer, and on lines 24-27 it creates that client from the PUCKPAY_URL and PUCKPAY_API_KEY environment variables. On line 36 it passes the client to BookingService, and on line 45 to IceMonitorService. The presentation layer never calls PuckPayClient itself; it only builds the client and hands it on. Even so, the import is a direct edge from presentation to persistence that skips the business layer, so FF-S03 flags it. The same file has similar wiring imports for the other repositories and clients (lines 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 10), so this edge is one example of a wider pattern: the composition root sits inside the presentation layer. It is not a stray data-access call from a controller.
